faq.question: How do I navigate the website?
faq.answer: Use the navigation bar at the top of the page. From there you can go to Home, Browse movies, view the Authors page, or open the FAQ page.

faq.question: What can I do on the Browse page?
faq.answer: The Browse section allows you to explore movies using different filters so you can quickly find what you're looking for.

faq.question: What filters are available in the Browse section?
faq.answer: You can browse movies by Genre, Alphabetical order (A–Z), or by Release Year. Each option shows movies based on the selected filter.

faq.question: How do I add a movie to my favorites?
faq.answer: Click the heart icon on the bottom right of a movie card. The movie will be added to your Favorites section.

faq.question: How do I remove a movie from my favorites?
faq.answer: Click the heart icon again on a movie that is already in your favorites. This will remove it from the Favorites section.

faq.question: How can I see information about a movie?
faq.answer: Hover your mouse over a movie card to see details like the title, genre, release year, and runtime.

faq.question: What is the Recommended section?
faq.answer: The Recommended section on the homepage displays a selection of movies that are highlighted for users to explore first.

faq.question: What is the Favorites section used for?
faq.answer: The Favorites section stores movies that you have selected using the heart icon so you can quickly access them later.
